value.body: An automotive engineer designs, tests and improves vehicles and their parts, such as engines, transmissions, chassis, brakes and, increasingly, batteries and electric drives. Employers include vehicle makers, component suppliers and engineering services firms. A typical day involves CAD design work, running or analysing tests, and working with production and quality teams.

items.label: Common tools
items.value: CAD (CATIA, SolidWorks), simulation software, test rigs

items.label: Auto sector share of India's GDP

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually enter through campus placements as graduate engineer trainees in plants, design centres or testing labs. Student projects such as formula-style or electric vehicle competitions help when applying.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Basics of electric vehicles and batteries

value.title: At a glance
items: Many first jobs are on the shop floor or in quality before moving to design.
Electric vehicles are changing the skills in demand.
Next roles: design engineer, testing or validation lead, product engineer.
